column1: # Frozen baseline for the unsafe SAFETY-comment ratchet
# (tools/audit/unsafe_safety_comment_audit.py ratchet).
# Each row is a crate-qualified scope and the number of `unsafe { ... }` blocks
# in it that currently lack a non-placeholder SAFETY comment. The `(tests)` /
# `(benches)` suffix marks cargo test/bench targets, which are their own crate
# roots and outside the library's `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`.
#   scope<TAB>count
# The gate FAILS when a scope's live count EXCEEDS its baseline (a new
# unsafe-without-SAFETY block, or a new crate carrying one). It never fails on a
# DECREASE; instead it prints a nudge to lower the row. This is a ratchet, not a
# cleanup target - the intent is "no NEW unsafe without SAFETY", per the
# unsafe-code policy in the coding standards. Lower a row deliberately whenever
# you retire a violation; never raise one to admit a new block.
# Frozen 2026-09-23 from the tree at that revision.
